doc: Rifle line (1 sergeant, 7 troopers, 40 m service rifles) attack-moves on an unarmed dummy from 60 m. The line uses the A3 defaults (humanity.json line_attack_move: firing positions within the default coherency, stand while firing, fire on the move allowed, the 15 m attack-move leash). Pinned absolute DPS over the first contact turn, so the line's number is fixed beside the mortar, marksman and assault ones (sw-txnj.11).

probes.doc: Line DPS from its first shot at the dummy over turn 1, 14.55 (5%). Pinned by sw-txnj.11.
